instruction: Repair the CLI in {{entry}}. Read UTF-8 stdin. Split words on Unicode whitespace, preserve punctuation, normalize each word using Rust to_lowercase, and output one TSV row per normalized word sorted by Rust String order: word, count, first byte offset in the original UTF-8 input. End every row with newline; empty input produces no stdout. First offsets refer to the original spelling, even when normalization changes byte length. No external dependencies.
